item.title: Groundskeeper workshop opportunity - Cricket Ireland
item.description: A Cricket Pitch Maintenance Seminar - featuring Karl McDermott from Lord's - is now open for bookings

item.title: Recognition for Arun - Cricket Ireland
item.description: Connacht's Arun Babu has been recognised for his volunteering work in cricket at the recent Federation of Irish Sport's 2025 Volunteers in Sport Awards.

item.title: Coaching Focus - Cricket Ireland
item.description: Youth coach Hannah Pasley reflects on her own experience of getting involved with cricket and then her journey into the world of coaching at both club and provincial level.

item.title: New partner on board - Cricket Ireland
item.description: DUBLIN – Cricket Ireland has announced Sports Pro Travel as its first-ever Official Travel Partner – the agreement will see Sports Pro Travel manage the travel programme for the senior international squads, as well as putting together fan packages for Irish cricket fans to travel abroad and follow the senior squads.

item.title: Welcome, Sarah! - Cricket Ireland
item.description: Our new CEO, Sarah Keane, has had a busy first week at Cricket Ireland - but she took a few moments out to share her story with us about her "life in sport".

item.title: First Round revealed - Cricket Ireland
item.description: DUBLIN – First round draws have been made for the All-Ireland club cup competitions with some massive ties coming up.

item.title: Leadership change - Cricket Ireland
item.description: DUBLIN – Paul Stirling will step down as Ireland Men’s T20 International captain as a new planning cycle begins ahead of the 2028 ICC Men’s T20 World Cup – however, he will remain a valued member of the T20I squad and will remain captain of the one-day international squad.

item.title: Men's fixtures revealed - Cricket Ireland
item.description: The Ireland Men’s programme sees a significant increase in activity over the next 12 months - with the potential for more to be added over the coming months.

item.title: Women's big year ahead - Cricket Ireland
item.description: Ireland Women’s squad will feature in the fourth edition of the ICC Women’s Championship (ICCWC), and this has helped to shape a busy programme over the next 12 months (additional cricket may be added to it over the coming months).

item.title: Central contracts awarded - Cricket Ireland
item.description: DUBLIN – Cricket Ireland has today announced that central contracts have been agreed with 48 players across its senior men’s and women’s squads ahead of a busy summer.
